programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany is preparing a class speech on inner beauty in 'Suck Toad', then in 'Secret Admirer', Alvin believes that Kevin has a secret crush on one of the Chipettes. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play in 'Kiss Conspiracy', then in 'House Guests', Alvin secretly decides to rent out their house for a Hawaiian home-swap. (S1, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting isn't easy in 'Baby Mama Drama', then in 'Ballet Boys', when Alvin's soccer team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help their skills. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise The Chipmunks in 'The App', then in 'Don Juan Theodoro', Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating tips. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's teddy bear gets bear-napped in 'Switcheroo', and in 'The Paperboy', when Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay. (S3, ep 18)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike. (S1, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies in 'Members Only', then in 'The New Kid', Alvin befriends a lonely new kidl, but the new student may not be who he says he is. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon goes missing and no one else notices in 'Oh Brother Where Art Thou', then in 'The Wall', the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall. (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie. (S2, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave discovers he didn't graduate from high school and ends up in class with Alvin in 'Back to School', then in 'Bromance', Simon has found a new best friend, but then gets ditched. (S1, ep 16)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him in 'Alvin's Wild Weekend', then in 'For Whom the Bell Tolls', a hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool! (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real. (S3, ep 16)
